name: Bead of Blasting
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, M (a bead carved from a bone, horn, or ivory of any magical sonic creature, including high-level bards)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 5-ft. radius
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

When evoking this spell, you place a musical note to a bead, either by singing or playing an instrument, then toss the bead at the targeted area where it explodes with concussive force. Those in the radius affected by the spell take 3d8 points of damage. Furthermore, those in the area of effect who fail their Reflex save are deafened for 2d6 rounds.
